applicability: Current supported profile, actual applicable requirements and current authority.
source_semantics: Supported existing OOP private/organizational state; preserve valid prior facts.
target_semantics: Verified independent scope under current three-scope adoption contract.
authority: Existing private ownership or canonical operations signing/access/expected-ref policy; no new authority.
already_satisfied: Current scope-bound actual facts and stable requirement evidence; SHA/flag alone insufficient.
verification: Observe actual state and attributable sufficient evidence; remote publication requires signed canonical readback.
recovery: Retain old adoption and actual partial effects; inspect before retry and block only dependent unsafe work.

actions.action: Reconcile owned adapters/context and separately verify adoption; peers do not advance it.

enforcement.before: Eight commands and timing descriptors; no reviewed activation vocabulary or technical installation outcome.
enforcement.after: Same CLI envelopes, decisions, reason codes and exits; additive optional activation metadata and install-only procedure outcome. Full-readiness guards unchanged.
enforcement.rationale: Existing engine/adapter wire readers tested; additive descriptor fields. Unknown strict external parsers require review, not presumed compatibility.
enforcement.already_satisfied: Actual installed dispatch/probes and owned checkpoint match target; SHA alone is insufficient.
enforcement.recovery: Inspect actual active dispatch and journal phase under an exclusive owned lock; preserve verified active on staging failure; reconcile activated_pending_checkpoint before advancement. Never remove ongoing/recovery code or advance peer adoption.
enforcement.retention: one active plus at most one ordinary transient candidate; no historical snapshots
enforcement.target_commit: Resolve containing OOP Git commit after publication; never a future self-SHA.
